correctness.rationale: The M-matrix resolvent has nonnegative entries and the Cayley formula gives C=2R-I. Walsh eigenvalues 2 sum_{j in J} a_j yield a common diagonal return F_a(s)=E[1/(1+2s sum a_i X_i)], strictly falling from 1 to 2^-d<1/2. The positive-definite Hessian (singleton Bernoulli events) makes F strictly Schur-convex, so s_* follows the strict majorization order and the equal and capped-extreme configurations are the unique fixed-budget extremizers. Leave-one-out binomial convex order proves Theta_d strictly decreases toward 1, centered-moment expansion gives 1+1/(2d)+5/(8d^2)+O(d^-3), and the two-branch Bernoulli decomposition proves the epsilon^-1/2 singular coefficient. Independently checked exact d=2 cubic and its positive roots.
